=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40460-40474 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide`, `$head_start` moves forward only at a gate marker or gate-retry marker that names a SHA different from `$e.oid`. As a result, `$gate_reruns` counts stale `head=unknown` gate markers in the current head's cap. Those markers come from earlier or resolved episodes, or from a previous head, and every workflow_dispatch re-run writes one.
  WHY: The count reaches the cap too early, so the escalate branch at line 40474 adds `ai:needs-human` and posts a false "stopped ... 3 times after automatic re-dispatch" comment without the bounded automatic retries. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT because the failure is fail-safe. The highest rating (MAJOR → high) is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40450-40468 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The selectors in `_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide` compare the raw comment author login (`.a // ""`) with the literal `"github-actions"` instead of `"github-actions[bot]"`. The cited lines are 40450, 40461, 40463 and 40468, plus the batch at 39281/39282.
  WHY: The flagging reviewers say the real gate markers never match, so `$i` is null, the decision is `none`, and rate-limited PRs are never re-dispatched or escalated. They say the tests pass only because the fixtures use `github-actions` (tests/test_rate_limit_requeue.py:559/645). All three rated it BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this finding: the batch is GraphQL-sourced, and the repo documents that GraphQL reports the Actions bot as `github-actions` (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:281, scripts/comment_signature.py:111).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40488-40493 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In `run_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_pass`, if the `ai:needs-human` label write succeeds but posting the comment marker fails, the function exits without posting the terminal escalation comment.
  WHY: The PR keeps the label but has no terminal marker, so the next tick may retry the escalation, and the label and comment history disagree. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this finding as intended, documented semantics.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Entry point: the existing scheduled poller (AI Orchestrate Poller) for issues and the scheduled AI Review sweep for PRs."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml (scheduled PR-selection/dispatch path invoking `run_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_pass`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff does not modify .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml. `run_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_pass` is called only from scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40576 and iterates `_STANDALONE_ISSUELESS_RETRY_STATE` (line 40504), so PRs outside the conflict-sweep batch are excluded. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR; minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it as not a gap: the issue says "The implementer names the exact files", and review_autofix_sweep.yml is outside the plan's files_touched grant.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40460-40464 (used at 40474) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In `_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide`, `$gate_reruns` counts every github-actions gate marker with `head=unknown` after `$head_start`. Nothing resets that window when a later successful review (`later_review` at line 40468) resolves an episode. Every workflow_dispatch review writes `head=unknown` (review_autofix.yml:691), so stale markers keep counting. Example: gate(unknown) + review three times, then gate(head=A), gives `$attempts`=3 → `escalate`.
  WHY: `ai:needs-human` is added without any automatic re-dispatch, and the escalation comment falsely says "3 times after automatic re-dispatch", so the PR leaves the pipeline. Suggested fix: also advance `$head_start` at the newest non-marker pipeline comment (hardening for line 40462, about 2 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3).
- Notes: rejected the `github-actions[bot]` finding because GraphQL reports `github-actions` (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:281, scripts/comment_signature.py:111). Rejected the label-write escalation finding as intended design. Rejected the review_autofix_sweep.yml task gap because the plan grant excludes that file. Found the chained `source=0` replay in `_replay_rate_limited_clarify` does not widen trust.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40450, 40461, 40468 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The requeue logic compares the raw author login with "github-actions" instead of "github-actions[bot]".
  WHY: The poller fails to identify gate markers written by the job token, so it never re-dispatches or escalates rate-limited PRs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40461-40463 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `$gate_reruns` counts every github-actions `head=unknown` gate marker after `$head_start`, whether or not it belongs to the current head or to an episode a later review resolved.
  WHY: Over-counting makes PRs hit the cap early and escalate to `ai:needs-human`, skipping the intended retries.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40488-40493 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If the `ai:needs-human` label write succeeds but the comment marker post fails, `run_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_pass` exits without the terminal escalation comment.
  WHY: The label and comment history disagree, and the next tick may retry the escalation.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: "Entry point: the existing scheduled poller (AI Orchestrate Poller) for issues and the scheduled AI Review sweep for PRs."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff does not modify the file. The requeue pass is wired only to the issue-less conflict sweep poller.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40450, 40461, 40463, 40468 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The selectors compare `(.a // "") == "github-actions"`, but `_STANDALONE_ISSUELESS_RETRY_STATE` (line 39281) stores the raw `author.login`, and github.token comments are authored as `github-actions[bot]` (scripts/comment_signature.py:90; scripts/review_security_hold_sweep.py:93-94; lines 209, 356, 363, 373).
  WHY: `$i` is null, so the decision is `none||||` and the pass never re-dispatches or escalates. The tests pass only because the fixtures use `"login": "github-actions"` (tests/test_rate_limit_requeue.py:559).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40460-40463 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `$head_start` advances only at a SHA-named marker that differs from `$e.oid`. Unknown-head markers from workflow_dispatch re-runs never advance it, so `$gate_reruns` counts every unknown-head marker from the start of the array.
  WHY: Old unknown-head markers from a prior cycle (after a force-push or a reopen) count toward the new head's cap and cause a false escalation after one re-dispatch. tests/test_rate_limit_requeue.py:712-730 does not cover this case. The last run widened the count without giving `$head_start` a matching reset.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: "Entry point: the existing scheduled poller (`AI Orchestrate Poller`) for issues and the scheduled `AI Review` sweep for PRs. The implementer names the exact files." (linked issue #10031, §18.E Automation)
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml` should invoke `run_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_pass`
  Evidence of absence: The file is not in pr_changed_files.txt. The pass is called only at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40576 and iterates `_STANDALONE_ISSUELESS_RETRY_STATE` (line 40504), which excludes PRs the conflict sweep never saw.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:39282, 40450, 40461, 40463, 40468 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The review-gate logic recognises the marker author only when it equals `github-actions`. The marker is posted with github.token, and the bot login is `github-actions[bot]`. The tests use the `github-actions` fixture (tests/test_rate_limit_requeue.py:645).
  WHY: The real gate marker is never selected and the decision stays `none`, so rate-limited PRs are neither re-dispatched nor escalated.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40460-40464 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The retry count includes every `head=unknown` gate marker after the last marker that names a different SHA, and a successful review never resets it.
  WHY: Three historical markers can make a new head hit the cap immediately and escalate to `ai:needs-human` with a false report.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: "Entry point: the existing scheduled poller (AI Orchestrate Poller) for issues and the scheduled AI Review sweep for PRs."
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml` and its scheduled PR-selection/dispatch path.
  Evidence of absence: The requeue is not wired into review_autofix_sweep.yml. `run_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_pass` is called at the end of scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh instead.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40460-40464 (feeding escalate at 40474) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `$head_start` moves only at gate or gate-retry markers that name a different SHA, so unknown-head markers from a previous head's episode still count in `$gate_reruns`. Example: [gate head A, unknown ×3, gate head B] gives `$attempts`=3 → `escalate` on head B's first rc=75 failure.
  WHY: Head B loses its bounded retries and gets a false escalation label and comment. The failure is fail-safe: early escalation, no unbounded loop.
- Notes: rejected the `github-actions[bot]` finding because GraphQL reports `github-actions` (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:39226; scripts/gh_helpers.sh:281-282; scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1456; scripts/review_security_hold_sweep.py:40-42). Rejected the label-write escalation finding as intended semantics (agents.d fragment; test_poller_escalation_label_failure_keeps_requeue_label_and_posts_no_marker). Rejected the review_autofix_sweep.yml task gap because the PR wires the pass into the AI Orchestrate Poller (test_review_requeue_pass_wiring) and the file is outside files_touched. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
